final: SELECT AVG(avg_signed_amount) AS avg_signed_amount_across_accounts, AVG(avg_balance) AS avg_balance_across_accounts FROM (SELECT account_id, AVG(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -amount END) AS avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) AS avg_balance FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id)
